scientific_scope: coarse runtime-safe eligibility only; not a V_phys detector
selection_basis: deterministic clean-only rule; no training and no outcome input

inputs.finite_state: all required clean action/proprio values finite

rule.gate: finite_state AND clean_record_valid AND raw_action_7d[6] < 0.5 AND action_env_7d[6] > 0.5
rule.meaning: clean policy is issuing a physically closed/close-intent command, so a gripper-open perturbation could plausibly matter

invalid_policy: G_t=0 and no exploitability probe when any required clean value is missing/nonfinite
